continuity: Baek Museong has completed a year of secluded training and gained enlightenment that made him stronger and more profound.
Heavenly Sword True Person's five-day-old message reports Shaolin's blood calamity, Hong Dao's death, and Mae Jonghak's consideration as Alliance Leader of the revived Murim Alliance.
Baek Museong believes a bloody storm will soon engulf the Murim and intends for himself and Huashan to prevent it.
Hyuk Sopyung, known as the Zhongnan One Dragon, is a Peak master who defeated six First Rate Xi'an Tower guards while drunk and destroyed the private annex.
Baek Museong and Hyuk Sopyung know each other from several prior encounters, and Baek says their elders' connection has been passed down to them.
Taekyung, Cheongpung, and Gung Gibang have reached Xi'an while traveling toward Sichuan to find the Divine Physician.
plot: Baek Museong is staying at Xi'an Tower after completing a year of secluded training that deepened his strength and enlightenment. Five days earlier, Heavenly Sword True Person's messenger eagle brought news of Shaolin's blood calamity, Hong Dao's death, and Mae Jonghak's possible appointment as Alliance Leader of the revived Murim Alliance. Baek foresees a bloody storm over the Murim and resolves that he and Huashan must prevent it. Meanwhile, the drunk Zhongnan One Dragon, Hyuk Sopyung, defeats six First Rate guards and destroys the private annex while demanding better treatment. Taekyung, Cheongpung, and Gung Gibang reach Xi'an after nearly seven days of forced travel, and the guards admit them when Taekyung names Baek. They find Baek waiting in the devastated annex with his sword drawn.
translation_decisions: Use Zhongnan One Dragon for 종남일룡.
Continue using Xi'an Tower for 서안루 and Huashan Divine Dragon for 화산신룡.

active_continuity: The Jin Family Escort Bureau and the Yongbong Escort Bureau are business competitors; the Yongbong Escort Bureau remains dominant in Shaanxi, while the Jin Family Escort Bureau reportedly has more than five branches.
Ju Hwaran suspects an internal Yongbong Escort Bureau betrayal involving the leak of the Thousand-Year Snow Ginseng information and the attacks sustained over four months.
Ju Hwaran told Heo Jun to watch Song Ilseom; Taekyung and Cheongpung also noticed Song Ilseom's hostile attention toward Taekyung.
Song Ilseom is a Level 110 escort captain of the Yongbong Escort Bureau.
Cheongpung is known by the title Huashan Divine Dragon, bestowed after the Star-Array Grand Banquet.
Taekyung, Cheongpung, and Gung Gibang are traveling toward Sichuan to find the Divine Physician and have reached Xi'an after nearly seven days of forced travel.
Baek Museong is the direct Disciple of Heavenly Sword True Person, the first of Huashan's Three Plum Blossom Elites, and widely expected to become Huashan's future Sect Leader.
Baek Museong completed a year of secluded training and now foresees a bloody storm threatening the Murim.
Hyuk Sopyung, the Zhongnan One Dragon, is a Peak master who destroyed Xi'an Tower's private annex while drunk; Baek Museong is confronting him there.
open_questions: Is Song Ilseom involved in the Yongbong Escort Bureau's information leak and the repeated attacks?
Will Mae Jonghak become Alliance Leader of the revived Murim Alliance?
How will Baek Museong and Hyuk Sopyung's confrontation at Xi'an Tower unfold?
